metadataRaw.title: How to Fix a TILTED BACK for Instant Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix a tilted back (using no special equipment) for instant pain relief!

If you're dealing with stiffness, tightness, and pain in the back that's causing you to not STAND UP STRAIGHT -- this is a video you're not going to want to miss!

This video will show multiple exercises to help an ANTALIGIC LEAN, or tilt, following an injury or flare-up of chronic pain, tightness, and stiffness in the back.

These back stretching exercises are geared towards straightening bad back posture QUICKLY, even in as little as 30 seconds! Great part is they're EASY to do, require no special equipment, and can be done in the comfort of your own home. 

WATCH now and fix a tilted back at home for instant pain relief!

CHAPTERS:
0:00 Intro
0:46 Modified Child's Pose
2:46 Standing Child's Pose
4:05 Seated Lean Exercise
7:14 Wall Lean Stretch
8:50 Bed Lean Stretch
